description: Golden queries: find the table that answers a data question, from its grain, filters and purpose (and not a look-alike table). Warehouse answers directly, without the SQL review gate, as {"models_selected": [...], "proposed_sql": [...]} (empty lists when it cannot tell). Scores the selected source, that the proposed SQL reads the right table and compiles on Trino (EXPLAIN only, nothing runs), that the table was found, that no gate tool was used, and a 12-call budget.

cases.name: find_dataset_metadata
cases.query: Which DataHub dataset stores daily active users for the Tahoe product? Answer from the metric catalog and table schemas only: do not request SQL approval and do not run any SQL. If you cannot determine them, leave the lists empty: {"models_selected": [], "proposed_sql": []}.
